target_customer: Investment analysts and AI agent builders who need clean economic and financial data
problem: AI agents cannot reach exact numbers from filings, earnings calls and official statistics reliably, so research answers are shaky.
business_model: Subscription data access for people and AI agents
product_category: Economic and financial data for AI agents

founders.name: Rishabh Srivastava
previous_startups: A bootstrapped data API company reaching 100M+ monthly end users per the YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him an ML developer; education not stated.

founders.name: Medha Basu
previous_startups: An enterprise content marketing firm grown to seven figure revenue per the YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page: former journalist, editor and content marketer. Education not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cleaning and standardizing a very large number of time series from filings, calls and government sites is steady engineering, with query design for agents as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: The cleaned dataset takes effort to rebuild, but the sources are public and larger data vendors could add similar agent access.

market_need_then: Not documented at founding. Current founder posts claim agents recently became capable enough to use such data, with a self reported share of users coming through Claude.

branding.domain_note: Uses factiq.com per the company site.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct with contrast framing, such as your AI alone versus with FactIQ.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches surfaced several similar names such as Factiverse and Factors.ai and no press on the brand itself.

pivots.from: Defog.ai, natural language querying of data inside apps
pivots.to: FactIQ, economic and financial data for AI agents
pivots.why: A founder post says the company stopped training its own models in 2024 after stronger frontier models arrived. Exact FactIQ launch date is not confirmed.

outcome_analysis: FactIQ comes from the Defog.ai founders, who moved from model based natural language data querying to a data product for AI agents. The product now ships as a plugin for Claude and Codex with claimed 100 million plus time series. No funding was found for FactIQ itself, so its trajectory cannot be judged beyond early self reported usage.
notes: Defog.ai funding of about 2.7 million dollars and a November 2023 seed appear only on third party profile sites and are unverified, so no round is recorded. Directory data is for the FactIQ entry in W23. Funding for FactIQ was not found. No competitor sources dated near early 2023 were found. Founding year per YC page; launch timing conflicts across secondary sources.
